objective: Guarantee that newly verified progression and achievement events automatically produce exactly one player-facing celebratory notification/push, so the already-promoted full-screen reward UI is fed from authoritative System events without manual notification ceremony.

roles_before.artifact: Neon/PostgreSQL system_events owns verified progression, achievement and notification events.
quest.resolve/progression.awarded and system-level-xp:v1 own verified XP and derived level progression.
system-achievement-ledger:v1 owns deterministic verified achievement unlocks.
notification.pushed -> Web Push -> PWA owns transport; the player UI already deep-links REWARD/ACHIEVEMENT/SUCCESS pushes into a full-screen celebration.
system-controller.md resolves verified progression/achievement follow-through but should not manually duplicate feedback notifications.
Pre-activation progression/achievements remain immutable history and must not be backfilled into delayed duplicate push.
Git and append-only system_events preserve all pre-producer behavior and evidence.

role_dispositions.destination: Derived player feedback is appended as ordinary notification.pushed events; no second mutable feedback database is introduced.
The engine only reads progression.awarded and levelSnapshotForXp; it never awards XP/Coins or changes level state.
The engine reacts to achievement.unlocked but never creates or evaluates achievements.
Feed existing notification/Web Push transport automatically from one deterministic server-side feedback producer; keep consumer/UI path unchanged.
Controller explicitly avoids duplicate manual REWARD/ACHIEVEMENT notification pushes after verified progression/achievement writes.
Activation timestamp prevents backfilling seq 32/33 or any older progression/achievement.
Producer is versioned/idempotent and all generated notification events remain reconstructable from their source event ids.

capability_probes.assertion: A post-activation progression.awarded event yields exactly one deterministic SUCCESS/REWARD notification whose copy reflects XP/Coins and true level-threshold crossing.
A post-activation achievement.unlocked event yields exactly one deterministic SUCCESS/ACHIEVEMENT notification.
Pre-activation progression and achievements do not generate delayed notifications.
Feedback generation does not award XP/Coins, calibrate levels, unlock achievements, acknowledge notifications, or alter quests.
Existing push delivery/deep-link/full-screen celebration path continues to consume generated notifications without a new client-side owner.
Every generated feedback notification has deterministic source-event provenance and prior runtime behavior remains recoverable from Git/ledger.

tests.expected: reward/level-up/achievement planning, activation boundary and idempotent sweep PASS.
model/PostgreSQL/Docker runtime plus feedback-engine tests PASS; server health/capabilities expose system-player-feedback:v1.
promoted celebration/deep-link PWA remains green and controller/owner continuity remains coherent.
